correctness.rationale: PASS. The canonical 7-line Fano STS orbit has exactly 30 planes: independent enumeration of all 7! relabellings recovered a stabilizer of order 168 acting by even permutations, and precisely 15 planes in each sign class. For up to 2 specified lines, 7 points fall in at most 4 membership cells; an odd transposition in a cell fixes both constraints, hence annihilates their parity moment. Direct computation from all 30 plane incidence sets confirmed same-class intersection exactly one, opposite-class intersection either zero or three, and cross B B^T=4I+3J. The block Gram formulas then give eigenvalues 72,12,0 with multiplicities 1,14,15 for degree 1 and 114,39,15,0 with multiplicities 1,14,14,1 for degree 2. Exactly one STS extends lines 123,145,246, so a cubic monomial detects the last contrast and degree 3 spans 30 dimensions. This is an exact finite universe and explicit geometric proof, not extrapolation from a sample.
